question: Hello! How can I help you?
answer: Hi! 👋 I'm Aura from Theaurax.in — we sell football jerseys: clubs, national teams, retro and IPL. Which team's jersey are you looking for?
answerTanglish: Vanakkam! 👋 Naan Aura, Theaurax.in la irundhu. Club, national team, retro, IPL — football jerseys ellaam namma kitta iruku. Neenga endha team jersey paakureenga?

question: What payment methods do you accept? Is Cash on Delivery available?
answer: Cash on Delivery isn't available right now — all orders are prepaid. You can pay by UPI (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm), debit/credit card, net banking or wallet through our secure Razorpay payment link, which we send here on WhatsApp when you order. Shipping is free. Which jersey would you like?
answerTanglish: Sorry, ippo COD illa — ellaa order um prepaid dhaan. UPI (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm), debit/credit card, net banking, wallet — Razorpay payment link la pay pannalaam, order pannumbodhu link inga WhatsApp la anuppuvom. Shipping free. Endha jersey venum?

question: What are the shipping charges and delivery timelines?
answer: We deliver across India and shipping is free. Standard delivery takes 5–7 working days; customised jerseys (with a name printed) take 8–10 working days. Which jersey are you looking at?
answerTanglish: India full ah deliver pannuvom, shipping free dhaan. Normal ah 5–7 working days la delivery aagum; name print panna customised jersey na 8–10 working days aagum. Neenga endha jersey paakureenga?

question: What sizes do you have and is there a size chart?
answer: Sizes are different for each jersey — every product shows the sizes currently in stock. Tell me the team or player and I'll show you the exact sizes available. For measurements, see our size chart: https://theaurax.in/size-chart
answerTanglish: Ovvoru jersey ku sizes maarum — ippo stock la irukkura sizes product la kaattum. Team illa player peru sollunga, available sizes correct ah kaatturen. Measurements ku size chart paarunga: https://theaurax.in/size-chart

question: Can I customize the jersey with my own name and number?
answer: Yes, you can add a player name (or your own name) on the back. Our imported jerseys don't come with a name by default — name customisation is ₹300 extra, and customised jerseys take 8–10 working days to deliver. Which jersey would you like it on, and what name should we print?
answerTanglish: Aamaa, back la player name illa unga name podalaam. Imported jerseys la default ah name varaadhu — name customisation ku ₹300 extra aagum, customised jersey delivery ku 8–10 working days aagum. Endha jersey la, enna name podanum nu sollunga?

question: What is your return and exchange policy?
answer: Our team checks every exchange or return request personally. Please send your order number and what the issue is (a photo helps if the item is damaged or wrong), and the team will get back to you here.
answerTanglish: Exchange illa return request ellaam namma team dhaan personal ah check pannuvaanga. Unga order number um enna problem nu um anuppunga (damage illa wrong item na oru photo kooda anuppunga), team inga reply pannuvaanga.

question: What is the fabric quality and material of the jerseys?
answer:
Our imported jerseys come in 4 versions:
• *FC Set* — jersey + shorts, embroidered badges (the only one that comes with shorts)
• *Master / Fan Version* — the same version, two names: premium embroidery + premium fabric
• *Player Version* — dry-fit fabric, heat-pressed logos and badges
• *Retro Version* — vintage-style jersey with premium embroidery + premium fabric
The best one depends on what you like — if you want our pick, it's Player Version. Which team are you looking for?
answerTanglish:
Namma imported jerseys 4 version la varum:
• *FC Set* — jersey + shorts, embroidered badges (shorts varradhu idhula mattum dhaan)
• *Master / Fan Version* — rendum ore version dhaan: premium embroidery + premium fabric
• *Player Version* — dry-fit fabric, heat-pressed logos and badges
• *Retro Version* — vintage style jersey, premium embroidery + premium fabric
Best edhu nu unga preference poruthu — namma recommendation na Player Version. Neenga endha team jersey paakureenga?

question: How should I wash and care for my jersey?
answer: For best results: cold hand wash or gentle machine wash (inside-out), no bleach, no wringing, and air dry in shade rather than direct sunlight. Avoid ironing directly over any printed name/number or crest — iron inside-out on low heat if needed. This keeps the print and fabric looking fresh for way longer!
answerTanglish: Best result ku: cold water la hand wash illa gentle machine wash (inside-out ah thirupi), bleach venaam, pizhiya koodaathu, veyil la vaikaama nizhal la air dry pannunga. Print panna name/number mela direct ah iron panna koodaathu — inside-out ah low heat la pannunga. Print um fabric um romba naal fresh ah irukum!

question: Can I cancel my order?
answer: Please send your order number as soon as possible. If it hasn't been packed or shipped yet, the team will try to cancel it and will confirm with you here.
answerTanglish: Seekiram unga order number anuppunga. Innum pack illa ship aagala na team cancel panna try pannuvaanga, inga confirm pannuvaanga.

question: Do you have jerseys for kids?
